versions.changelog:
Initial release of audit-budget-performance skill.

- Implements a 7-step budget performance management workflow: target review, data collection, completion rate analysis, fund efficiency, satisfaction statistics, comprehensive scoring, and performance reporting.
- Provides command-line usage for workflow execution, preview, and visual export.
- Integrates with OpenClaw for workflow initiation.
- Requires pipeline_engine.py v3.0 and related audit modules.
